stem: I often ______ football with my good friends after school. (play)
detail: often 是一般现在时标志，主语 I 非三单，动词用原形 play。

stem: My mother usually ______ TV plays after dinner every evening. (watch)
detail: usually 表现在时，主语 My mother 是第三人称单数，watch 以 ch 结尾加 -es。

stem: My father often ______ to work every morning. (walk)
detail: every morning 表现在时，主语第三人称单数，动词加 -s。

stem: We ______ our grandparents last Sunday. (visit)
detail: last Sunday 表过去，动词用过去式 visited。

stem: Zhang Peng ______ English yesterday. (study)
detail: 辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 -ed。

stem: I ______ to school with my best friend yesterday morning. (walk)
detail: 一般情况直接加 -ed。

stem: He ______ (study) Maths hard and ______ (get) a good grade yesterday.
detail: study→studied（辅音+y），get 不规则→got。

stem: We ______ (go) to the zoo and ______ (see) many lovely animals last Sunday.
detail: 不规则动词 go→went, see→saw。

stem: They ______ (stop) and ______ (chat) with each other under the tree just now.
detail: 重读闭音节双写末辅音：stop→stopped, chat→chatted。

stem: —______ you watch TV last night? —Yes, I ______.
detail: 实义动词 watch，一般疑问句用 Did，回答用 did。

stem: —______ they in the library yesterday? —No, they ______.
detail: 含 be 动词、主语 they 复数，用 Were，否定回答 weren't。

stem: —______ ______ with your sister? —My sister has a bad cold.
detail: 询问某人怎么了：What's wrong/the matter with sb.?
询问感觉：How does/do sb. feel? 主语第三人称单数用 does。

stem: I ______ ______ ______ ______ eat junk food any more. (not eat)
detail: I 搭配 am，否定在 be 后加 not：am not going to。

stem: ______ your sister ______ ______ ______ a doctor tomorrow morning? (see)
detail: 主语第三人称单数用 Is，一般疑问句把 be 提前。

stem: Lily ______ need to take an umbrella today. It's sunny. (do)
detail: 主语第三人称单数，否定用 doesn't。

stem: I ______ to eat some candy now. (want)
detail: 主语 I 非三单，用原形 want。

stem: He ______ to finish his homework before dinner. (need)
detail: need 作实义动词，主语第三人称单数加 -s。

stem: We can get extra pocket money ______ selling old storybooks.
detail: by 表「通过某种方式」，后接动名词 selling。

stem: —How do you pay ______ the robot show ticket? —With my pocket money.
detail: pay for 后接购买的对象。

stem: There ______ any milk in the fridge. Let's go and buy some. (be)
detail: milk 不可数用 is，否定 isn't；any 用于否定句。

stem: There ______ no water in the glass. (be)
detail: water 不可数，no 后不用 any，be 用 is。

stem: ______ (learn) English well, you must read more.
detail: 句首表目的用不定式，逗号与主句隔开。

stem: We plant trees ______ (make) our city beautiful.
detail: 不定式表目的，动词原形前加 to。

stem: Time ______ quickly when you are busy.
detail: 主语 time 是物、自身耗尽，用不及物 run out，第三人称单数加 -s。

stem: She ______ all her energy after finishing the marathon.
detail: 主语 She 是人、用完某物且后接宾语 energy，用 run out of，过去式 ran out of。
